Col.description: Vertical content layout. Spacing values use four-pixel steps.

Box.description: Configurable flex box with safe lengths, color, border, and rounded clipping.

Grid.signature: Grid(children: any, columns?: number, minChildWidth?: number, gap?: number)
Grid.description: Equal-width grid, optionally responsive to a minimum child width in pixels.

Card.signature: Card(children: any, variant?: "outline" | "soft", padding?: number, gap?: number)
Card.description: Rounded panel with an outline or a soft filled surface.

Carousel.signature: Carousel(children: any, itemWidth?: number, gap?: number)
Carousel.description: Keyboard-scrollable horizontal collection with snapping items.

Title.description: A semantic heading with a selectable size and safe text color.

Text.signature: Text(text: any, size?: "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg", color?: string, weight?: "normal" | "medium" | "semibold", italic?: boolean, lineThrough?: boolean, tabularNums?: boolean, maxLines?: number)
Text.description: Paragraph content with inline Markdown or embedded inline components.

Label.description: A visible group or field label.

Badge.description: A small colored tag with an optional local Lucide icon.

Markdown.description: Markdown prose, tables, lists, code, Host-mediated HTTP(S) links and validated public images. Raw HTML and direct browser networking are disabled.

Quote.description: A quotation with an optional plain-text source.

Code.description: Locally highlighted code with explicit plain-text fallback and user-initiated Host copy of the original source.

Math.description: Local KaTeX formula rendered as native MathML with trusted commands disabled.

Link.description: Requests the Host to open an absolute HTTP(S) URL after a user click; reports Host acceptance without claiming the page loaded.

List.description: Bulleted, numbered, or unmarked items with optional timeline connectors.

ListItem.signature: ListItem(title: string, description?: string, marker?: string, children?: any)
ListItem.description: List content with title, description, a custom marker, and nested content.

Icon.description: A locally bundled Lucide icon; unknown names have an explicit fallback.

Button.signature: Button(label: string, action?: ActionExpression, variant?: "solid" | "outline" | "soft" | "ghost", color?: "primary" | "danger" | "success", size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg", icon?: string, disabled?: boolean, block?: boolean)
Button.description: An action button. Without an action, sends its label to the assistant.

IconButton.signature: IconButton(icon: string, action?: ActionExpression, label?: string, variant?: "outline" | "ghost" | "solid")
IconButton.description: A round icon action button with an accessible label.

Input.description: A reactive text or number input. Numeric edits store numbers; an empty field stores an empty string.

TextArea.signature: TextArea(value: $binding<string>, label?: string, placeholder?: string, rows?: number)

Select.signature: Select(value: $binding<string>, options: (string | {value: string, label: string})[], label?: string, placeholder?: string)
Select.description: A reactive dropdown of string choices or value/label objects.

Checkbox.description: A reactive checkbox; optionally strike the checked label through.

Slider.signature: Slider(value: $binding<number>, min: number, max: number, step?: number, label?: string, unit?: string, marks?: {value: number, label: string}[])
Slider.description: A reactive range input with a value label and optional marks.

SegmentedControl.signature: SegmentedControl(value: $binding<string>, options: (string | {value: string, label: string})[], block?: boolean)
SegmentedControl.description: Reactive short choices arranged in a row.

RadioGroup.signature: RadioGroup(value: $binding<string>, options: (string | {value: string, label: string, description?: string})[], label?: string, variant?: "list" | "pills" | "cards")
RadioGroup.description: A reactive single choice displayed as a list, pills, or cards.

DatePicker.signature: DatePicker(value: $binding<string>, label?: string, min?: string, max?: string)
DatePicker.description: A reactive date input using YYYY-MM-DD values.

Form.description: Groups fields and passes their current state with assistant actions.

Image.signature: Image(src: string, alt: string, aspectRatio?: number, radius?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "full" | number, fit?: "cover" | "contain")
Image.description: A local bitmap or public HTTP(S) image loaded through the parent image service, with visible source and loading/error states. No replacement-image fallback.

SearchImage.signature: SearchImage(query: string, aspectRatio?: number, radius?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "full" | number, fit?: "cover" | "contain")
SearchImage.description: Searches the parent image service for real bitmap images and retains their original source URLs.

Popover.description: Local disclosure panel with Escape, outside dismissal, and focus restoration.

Flashcard.signature: Flashcard(front: any, back: any, hint?: string)
Flashcard.description: Two-sided card with mouse, touch, and keyboard flipping; respects reduced motion.

Celebration.description: Local, time-bounded confetti on a rising condition; static feedback for reduced motion.

Chart.signature: Chart(type: "bar" | "line" | "area" | "pie" | "donut" | "scatter", data: Record<string, string | number>[], x?: string, series?: string[], format?: "number" | "currency" | "percent", currency?: string, stacked?: boolean, height?: number)
Chart.description: Data charts: bar, line, area, pie, donut, and scatter. Hover or focus real data marks; arrow keys inspect exact values. Stacking is available for bar, line, and area. The public contract does not specify stacked pie, donut, or scatter semantics; these combinations are not implemented. Pie and donut render one chart per selected series. Missing values are gaps; negative pie or donut values are rejected.

Table.description: Each row lists its cells in column order. Component cells render inline and numeric columns align right.

Svg.description: Responsive native SVG drawing with evaluated shape children and a numeric viewBox.

Ellipse.signature: Ellipse(cx: number, cy: number, rx: number, ry: number, fill?: string, stroke?: string, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)
Ellipse.description: Ellipse with horizontal and vertical radii.

Rect.signature: Rect(x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number, fill?: string, stroke?: string, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number, rx?: number)
Rect.description: Rectangle with an optional rounded-corner radius.

Line.signature: Line(x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number, stroke?: string, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)

Path.signature: Path(d: string, fill?: string, stroke?: string, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)
Path.description: Native SVG path supporting standard move, line, curve, arc, and close commands.

Polyline.signature: Polyline(points: string, stroke?: string, strokeWidth?: number, fill?: string, opacity?: number)
Polyline.description: Connected open line segments from x,y coordinate pairs.

Polygon.signature: Polygon(points: string, fill?: string, stroke?: string, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)
Polygon.description: Closed polygon from x,y coordinate pairs.

G.signature: G(children: any, transform?: string, opacity?: number)
G.description: SVG drawing group with a numeric SVG transform and opacity.

SvgText.signature: SvgText(text: string, x: number, y: number, size?: number, fill?: string, anchor?: "start" | "middle" | "end", weight?: "normal" | "medium" | "semibold")
SvgText.description: Escaped SVG text with positioning, font size, color, alignment, and weight.

Map.signature: Map(markers: MapMarker[], route?: boolean, selected?: string, height?: number)
Map.description: A real raster street map fitted to its markers, with optional road route and bound selection.

MapMarker.signature: MapMarker(label: string, lat: number, lng: number, category?: string, icon?: string)
MapMarker.description: A labeled map location; icon is an emoji, otherwise its position number is shown.

Pressable.signature: Pressable(children: any[], action?: ActionExpression, selected?: boolean, padding?: number, background?: string, radius?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "full" | number)
Pressable.description: Clickable content with optional selected styling and a local or assistant action.

Timer.description: A start/pause/reset countdown that updates its bound seconds and stops at zero.

HtmlView.signature: HtmlView(html: string, height?: number, title?: string)
HtmlView.description: An isolated local HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript page for games and canvas. Content auto-sizes unless height is set. No CDN, network, media, host actions or persistent state.

YouTube.description: An explicitly loaded, Host-owned native YouTube seat. The isolated viewer itself never embeds or fetches video; Host creation status does not confirm playback.
